score_definition: Coverage rubric only: chemistry 40%, spatial coordinates 20%, hydrogeology metadata 20%, temporal span/repeated-site sampling 20%. Missingness is not a vulnerability score; repeated national records are not ISR phase coverage.

data_gaps.why_it_matters: The baseline extract contains uranium only; multivariate anomaly analysis and co-contaminant interpretation are unsupported.
data_gaps.suggested_action: Run the documented multi-parameter WQP downloader and verify shared activity identifiers.

data_gaps.gap: hydraulic head, gradient, and flow direction
data_gaps.why_it_matters: Coordinates alone do not identify upgradient/downgradient connectivity.
data_gaps.suggested_action: Obtain contemporaneous water-level elevations from a hydrogeologist and derive gradient only within a defensible connected aquifer.

data_gaps.gap: well screen, aquifer/geology, site baseline and ISR-zone geometry
data_gaps.why_it_matters: Optional station attributes are incomplete and do not provide screen intervals, site baseline phases, or connected ISR geometry.
data_gaps.suggested_action: Add verified well construction, aquifer framework, repeated baseline data, and user-supplied hypothetical ISR polygon; preserve scenario labels.

data_gaps.why_it_matters: Repeated national observations do not establish matched pre-operation, operation, and restoration sampling at one ISR site.
data_gaps.suggested_action: Acquire repeated site-specific measurements with documented phase, method, and detection limits.
